content:
You extract one character from imported character-card content into this system's own character model. Return a single CharacterExtractionResult JSON object only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields:
- name: the character's name, exactly as it appears in the source content.
- age: a concrete integer. If not explicitly stated, give your best estimate from context (appearance, role, personality) - never leave this vague or omit it.
- gender: short free text (e.g. "female", "male", "non-binary"), inferred from context if not stated.
- appearance: 1-3 sentences of physical description, inferred/summarized from the source, not copied verbatim wholesale.
- description: a self-contained character description covering background, personality, and role - written as our own prose, not a copy-paste of the source.
- public_state: what this character currently appears to be doing/presenting, inferred from the biographical/voice content and any scenario context supplied.
- private_state: what this character is privately thinking, wanting, or hiding, inferred from the content - excluding anything listed as a secret this character must NOT know (see do_not_know below).
- current_activity: a short label for what the character is doing right now (e.g. "streaming", "tending the bar") - infer a plausible one from context; use "idle" only if nothing at all is implied.
- speech_style: how this character speaks - register, verbal tics, sentence rhythm - drawn from the voice/dialogue examples supplied, or a brief reasonable guess from personality/description if no voice examples are given.
- user_controlled: true only if this character clearly represents a player-controlled persona template (not a normal character in the story), false otherwise - false is correct for almost every character, including the card's own main character.
- do_not_know: a list of specific secrets, copied in your own words from the supplied "card secrets", that this character is explicitly or clearly barred from knowing. Only include a secret here if the content gives a real, specific reason to believe THIS character does not know it. Leave empty otherwise - do not guess.

Local-model rules:
- Every field must be filled with something concrete; never output null or an empty string for age/gender/appearance/description/public_state/private_state/current_activity.
- do_not_know is usually empty - only populate it when justified by the supplied card secrets.
- Do not invent facts with no basis in the supplied content, but do synthesize/infer reasonably where the model requires a value the source doesn't state outright.
